why: Beds explode when used in the End, and an explosion next to the perched dragon removes up to a quarter of its health per bed. The dragon only stays still while perched, so that is when the beds are used. The blast also hurts you, so a block between you and the bed is standard. Sword damage is small (the dragon takes about a quarter of damage that misses its head), so A takes many perches. C wastes beds on a moving target from the ground. D spends minutes on crystals. The one-cycle (B) usually needs fewer than 7 beds, 4-5 for advanced players. E is the zero-cycle, a harder expert method that skips the wait for a perch, so it is also accepted. The agent on this project's seed killed the dragon with six bed explosions on one perch.
trap: A or D: the 'normal player' sword fight, which is many times slower.
fairness_note: Two answers are accepted: one-cycle (B) and zero-cycle (E). Both are documented speedrun strategies.
